hotspots.label: Myth: passing this capstone makes the partner competency-certified.
hotspots.detail: Competencies require an audit process. This badge prepares the evidence.

hotspots.label: Myth: the architecture review can be skipped if the code is good.
hotspots.detail: The competency requires a custom connector architecture review with a Glean technical resource.

hotspots.label: Myth: once earned, the competency is permanent.
hotspots.detail: It is validated every 18 months. Renewal needs written documentation from a customer within 3 months before renewal.
